pairs: Eodem autem tempore misit Herodes rex manus,
Now at the same time, king Herod extended his hand,
in order to afflict some from the Church.
Occidit autem Jacobum fratrem Joannis gladio.
Then he killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.
And seeing that it pleased the Jews,
he set out next to apprehend Peter also.
Now it was the days of Unleavened Bread.
So when he had apprehended him,
handing him over into the custody of four groups of four soldiers,
volens post Pascha producere eum populo.
intending to produce him to the people after the Passover.
Et Petrus quidem servabatur in carcere.
And so Peter was detained in prison.
Oratio autem fiebat sine intermissione ab ecclesia ad Deum pro eo.
But prayers were being made without ceasing, by the Church, to God on his behalf.
Cum autem producturus eum esset Herodes,
And when Herod was ready to produce him,
in ipsa nocte erat Petrus dormiens inter duos milites,
in that same night, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers,
and was bound with two chains.
et custodes ante ostium custodiebant carcerem.
And there were guards in front of the door, guarding the prison.
And behold, an Angel of the Lord stood near,
and a light shined forth in the cell.
And tapping Peter on the side,
Et ceciderunt catenæ de manibus ejus.
And the chains fell from his hands.
Then the Angel said to him:
And going out, he followed him.
And he did not know this truth:
that this was being done by an Angel.
For he thought that he was seeing a vision.
Transeuntes autem primam et secundam custodiam,
And passing by the first and second guards,
they came to the iron gate which leads into the city;
and it opened for them by itself.
they continued on along a certain side street.
et continuo discessit angelus ab eo.
And suddenly the Angel withdrew from him.
Nunc scio vere quia misit Dominus angelum suum,
“Now I know, truly, that the Lord sent his Angel,
et eripuit me de manu Herodis, et de omni exspectatione plebis Judæorum.
and that he rescued me from the hand of Herod and from all that the people of the Jews were anticipating.”
Consideransque venit ad domum Mariæ matris Joannis,
And as he was considering this, he arrived at the house of Mary,
the mother of John, who was surnamed Mark,
ubi erant multi congregati, et orantes.
where many were gathered and were praying.
Then, as he knocked at the door of the gate,
processit puella ad audiendum, nomine Rhode.
a girl went out to answer, whose name was Rhoda.
And when she recognized the voice of Peter,
out of joy, she did not open the gate,
sed intro currens nuntiavit stare Petrum ante januam.
but instead, running in, she reported that Peter stood before the gate.
Illa autem affirmabat sic se habere.
But she reaffirmed that this was so.
But Peter was persevering in knocking.
Annuens autem eis manu ut tacerent,
But motioning to them with his hand to be silent,
narravit quomodo Dominus eduxisset eum de carcere,
he explained how the Lord had led him away from prison.
Et egressus abiit in alium locum.
he went away to another place.
erat non parva turbatio inter milites,
there was no small commotion among the soldiers,
as to what had happened concerning Peter.
Herodes autem cum requisisset eum et non invenisset,
And when Herod had requested him and did not obtain him,
And descending from Judea into Caesarea,
Now he was angry with those of Tyre and Sidon.
But they came to him with one accord,
At illi unanimes venerunt ad eum,
who was over the bedchamber of the king,
eo quod alerentur regiones eorum ab illo.
because their regions were supplied with food by him.
Statuto autem die Herodes vestitus veste regia sedit pro tribunali, et concionabatur ad eos.
Then, on the appointed day, Herod was clothed in kingly apparel, and he sat in the judgment seat, and he gave a speech to them.
Then the people were crying out,
Confestim autem percussit eum angelus Domini,
And immediately, an Angel of the Lord struck him down,
eo quod non dedisset honorem Deo:
because he had not given honor to God.
And having been consumed by worms,
But the word of the Lord was increasing
Barnabas autem et Saulus reversi sunt ab Jerosolymis expleto ministerio assumpto Joanne, qui cognominatus est Marcus.
Then Barnabas and Saul, having completed the ministry, returned from Jerusalem, bringing with them John, who was surnamed Mark.
